subject: physical-education
instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain off-ball movement in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of transition.
Apply defensive systems in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving decision speed; correct it and explain why.
Connect off-ball movement with video-free tactical analysis. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Analyze and implement a tactical improvement in a chosen invasion, net, target, or striking game.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Advanced Game Strategy?
